warning: A source commit token does not cover writers marked pending or external. Do not claim full multi-file source consistency until they join the contract.

preparation.note: Whole regeneration captures one target/options, prepares outside the gate, compares dependencies and commits all generated artifacts plus settings/scope together. Cache adoption and compatibility notifications follow commit. Profile lifecycle/defaults authority remain pending.

sources.note: No in-repository producer found. ProfileManager.saveSettings writes WeaponX/settings.plist, a different path; it must not be claimed as this writer.

identifier-settings-scope.boundary: Stage settings and scope under one source gate; notify only after outer commit returns.

profile-lifecycle.boundary: Prepare target artifacts before committing active selection. createProfile currently launches async generation after switching; do not hold a lexical lock across that dispatch or external completion. Profile deletion requires a separately reviewed directory lifecycle boundary.

identifier-artifacts.boundary: Fixed-target prepare/compare/commit of enabled groups, unconditional WiFi, missing theme and settings/scope. One source commit; no provider/setter callback under source gate. Cache-only adoption and legacy battery mirror/notifications after commit; inactive target skips global cache adoption. Schema migration and directory lifecycle precede this boundary. Legacy defaults writers and total cache ordering remain separate.

identifier-telephony.boundary: Freeze manual input; capture target and source basis once; resolve regional policy/generate outside gate; compare dependencies and commit sidecar/IDs/counter together. Preserve non-iPhone manual compatibility. Directory/profile lifecycle and DB catalog generation are separate.

identifier-dependencies.boundary: Prepare outside gate, merge owned keys at fixed target, journal legacy cellular removal with IDs. Software/cellular refresh compares captured dependencies before commit; compatibility callbacks after top-level commit. Directory lifecycle, defaults and cache ordering remain separate.

identifier-values.boundary: Capture target before preparation; pair sidecars and IDs under gate; generated/custom compatibility publishers run after top-level commit. Serial retains its policy adapter. Standalone provider generation still publishes by its API contract; ordering between concurrent cache publishers remains separate.

identifier-migration.boundary: One gate covers legacy reads, sidecars, schema marker and single generation bump. Recheck schema after acquiring gate; thread-local reentry flag restored in finally.

battery.boundary: Profile battery_info and device_ids pair; the legacy global battery preference is not a direct snapshot source.

network.boundary: Network/carrier/device_ids update and RMW must share a captured target profile.

storage.boundary: Use explicit target profile; group with model/device_ids when invoked from a model update.

storage-preference.boundary: NSUserDefaults suite writes can flush after returning and rewrite the same tlink settings file; a lock around synchronize alone is not a complete writer contract.

dashboard-preview.boundary: Dashboard invokes setters that mutate device_ids before a final tuple write and storage setters. Enlist as one staged transaction after generation/validation.

security-store.boundary: Existing security-only flock is separate. Compatibility defaults mirror must run after source commit; async cfprefsd writes need authority reconciliation.

security-direct.boundary: Includes direct plist, NSUserDefaults and CFPreferences writes. Non-runtime keys still share the same physical security plist and cannot be ignored.

preferences-daemon.boundary: Must settle canonical source authority and preserve legacy suite compatibility; cannot make cfprefsd acquire a private lock by wrapping UI setters.

upgradeWriters.note: Legacy preferences and ProjectX data migration run after stopping old daemon and before new publisher self-test; legacy binaries and concurrent manual commands do not join the new lock.

excludedAfterInspection.reason: Reads active selection to locate backups; inspected direct write calls are debug output, not these source plists. App container restore has separate transactions.
Inspected profile edits write identifiers/scoped-apps/info/appdata display files, not the global scope or runtime artifact paths.
Writes its location preference, reads global scope; location data is not in this runtime snapshot schema.
